import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data from iris.csv
data = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv', names=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width', 'species'])

# Map species to numerical values for plotting
species_map = {'setosa': 0, 'versicolor': 1, 'virginica': 2}
data['species'] = data['species'].map(species_map)

# Create a scatter plot of petal length vs petal width for each species
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
sns.scatterplot(
    x='petal_width',
    y='petal_length',
    hue='species',
    data=data,
    palette='husl'
)

# Set labels and title
plt.title('Petal Length vs Petal Width by Species')
plt.xlabel('Petal Width (cm)')
plt.ylabel('Petal Length (cm)')
plt.legend(title='Species')

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
